purpose: Proton sigma(E) for 7-series SRAM FPGA. Filled ONLY where a citable measured table exists; other entries stay explicit gaps. Do not feed this file into the heavy-ion Weibull strike path.
why_needed: LEO / SAA proton fluence dominates many orbits. The MEO 20200 km GCR heavy-ion N_SEU line can exist without this table. Mixing proton sigma(E) into Lee LET Weibull is a particle-species error.

filled_from.source: M. J. Wirthlin, H. Takai, A. Harding, 'Soft error rate estimations of the Kintex-7 FPGA within the ATLAS Liquid Argon (LAr) Calorimeter', 2014 JINST 9 C01025 (open access, peer-reviewed). Table 1, row 'TSL (180 MeV Proton)'.
filled_from.device_tested: Xilinx Kintex-7 XC7K325T (28 nm), same DUT family as Lee REDW 2014 heavy-ion Table 1
filled_from.same_paper_neutron_anchor: Table 1 LANSCE (WS neutron) CRAM 6.89e-15 / BRAM 6.15e-15 cm2/bit - independent cross-check of UG116 v10.20 (5.69e-15 / 5.57e-15): same order, within 21%/10%.

additional_sources_not_extracted.title: Single Event Upset Characterization of the Kintex-7 Field Programmable Gate Array Using Proton Irradiation
additional_sources_not_extracted.authors: Hiemstra, Kirischian, Kellner, von Przewoski, Dittrich
additional_sources_not_extracted.what_it_contains: Proton sigma(E) curve for Kintex-7 CRAM at 80/100/184 MeV (Fig. 2) plus functional blocks.
additional_sources_not_extracted.why_not_extracted: IEEE paywalled; no numeric table accessible in this audit (2026-08-22). Figure-only; extracting points requires licensed access or WebPlotDigitizer against the published figure - NOT done here, no values invented.

FF.gap_note: No measured FF proton sigma found in accessible literature. Hiemstra REDW 2014 covers functional blocks but is paywalled.

DSP.gap_note: No DSP48E1 proton sigma in any accessible source (same gap as heavy ion; see dsp_seu_gap.json).

usage_limits: Single energy point (180 MeV); an energy-dependent table still needs Hiemstra Fig. 2 extraction or new beam data.
Cross-section is for the tested device XC7K325T; borrowed to other 28 nm 7-series parts under the same-family rule as the Lee Weibull data.
Do not mix into the heavy-ion Weibull kernel; separate proton environment spectra integration is required before any orbit rate use.
layout_ecc_usage_note: Strike GUI uses Lee heavy-ion sigma(LET), not this file. This table exists so a future LEO/SAA proton line has a sourced starting point.
